definition: Sexual misconduct, classically prohibited in ethical training.
notes: This is an explicitly sexual ethical term. It should not be used to back-project a sexual default onto the broader kāma family.

example_phrases.translation: gives up sexual misconduct and refrains from sexual misconduct
example_phrases.notes: The running-text form in AN 8.39. The record previously cited `kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī` to this discourse, which does not contain `veramaṇī` in any form; the strict verifier scored that as `inflected` rather than `absent` because each stem occurs elsewhere in the text. Repaired 2026-09-13 with the AN 8.39 packet.
